screens.name: Price Book Management
screens.purpose: Let a user view, create, copy, edit, and delete Price Book records, including version history metadata

screens.name: Price Category Management
screens.purpose: Let a user, after selecting a Price Book, view, create, copy, edit, and delete Price Categories organized by Service Line

screens.name: Price Header Management
screens.purpose: Let a user, after selecting a Price Book and Price Category, view, create, copy, edit, and delete hierarchical Price Headers (with parent/child grouping)

screens.name: Price Item Management
screens.purpose: Let a user, after selecting a Price Book, Price Category, and Price Header, view, create, copy, edit, and delete the actual Price Item records
